sn45.29:1.4: Pleasant feeling, painful feeling, neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.
sn45.29:1.6: “The Noble Eightfold Path, bhikkhus, is to be developed for the full understanding of these three feelings.
sn45.29:1.7: What is the Noble Eightfold Path?
sn45.29:1.8: It is: right view … right concentration.
sn45.29:1.9: The Noble Eightfold Path is to be developed for the full understanding of these three feelings.”
